mapper.sql: case when exists ( select 1 from proj_material_flow f where f.material_id = ${alias}.id and f.flow_type = '领取' and f.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(f.pickup_type, 'paper') in ('electronic', 'both') ) then case when exists ( select 1 from proj_material_flow f2 where f2.material_id = ${alias}.id and f2.flow_type = '领取' and f2.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(f2.pickup_type, 'paper') in ('paper', 'both') ) then 'received_both' else 'received_electronic' end when exists ( select 1 from proj_material_flow f3 where f3.material_id = ${alias}.id and f3.flow_type = '领取' and f3.del_flag = '0' ) then 'received_paper' else 'pending' end

select m.id, m.project_id, m.submit_time, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.result_type, m.archive_dir, m.submit_status, m.guarantor_flag, m.guarantor_id, m.guarantor_name, as status, m.extra_data::text as extra_data, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark from proj_material m
mapper.select: select m.id, m.project_id, m.submit_time, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.result_type, m.archive_dir, m.submit_status, m.guarantor_flag, m.guarantor_id, m.guarantor_name, m.archive_flag, m.archive_time, as status, m.extra_data::text as extra_data, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, p.project_name, p.project_code, p.engineering_project, p.project_location from proj_material m left join proj_project p on p.id = m.project_id where m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into proj_material( project_id, submit_time, contact_name, contact_phone, result_type, archive_dir, status, submit_status, guarantor_flag, guarantor_id, guarantor_name, archive_flag, extra_data, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{projectId}, #{submitTime}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{resultType}, #{archiveDir}, #{status}, #{submitStatus}, #{guarantorFlag}, #{guarantorId}, #{guarantorName}, #{archiveFlag}, #{extraData}::jsonb, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now() )

select column_name as "columnName", coalesce(col_description(#{tableName}::regclass, ordinal_position), column_name) as "columnComment" from information_schema.columns where table_name = #{tableName} order by ordinal_position

select coalesce(c.contract_amount, 0) as "contractAmount", coalesce(pa.received, 0) as "receivedAmount", coalesce(c.contract_amount, 0) - coalesce(pa.received, 0) as "pendingAmount", case when c.contract_amount is null or c.contract_amount = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(pa.received, 0) * 100.0 / c.contract_amount, 1) end as "paymentRatio", case when coalesce(c.contract_amount, 0) - coalesce(pa.received, 0) > 0 then true else false end as "hasDebt" from proj_project p left join proj_contract c on c.id = p.contract_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join ( select project_id, sum(case when payment_type = 'refund' then -coalesce(amount, 0) else coalesce(amount, 0) end) as received from proj_payment where del_flag = '0' group by project_id ) pa on pa.project_id = p.id where p.id = #{projectId}
